title: Process Restricted Friend Requests
goal: Accept friendship requests only when no restricted pair becomes connected.
strategy: Before joining two components, check whether any restricted pair has endpoints in those two components. Failed requests leave the disjoint sets unchanged; requests inside one component are already safe.

phasePurposes.start: Accept friendship requests only when no restricted pair becomes connected.
phasePurposes.inspect: Before joining two components, check whether any restricted pair has endpoints in those two components. Failed requests leave the disjoint sets unchanged; requests inside one component are already safe.
phasePurposes.update: Before joining two components, check whether any restricted pair has endpoints in those two components. Failed requests leave the disjoint sets unchanged; requests inside one component are already safe.
phasePurposes.done: Accept friendship requests only when no restricted pair becomes connected.

edgeCases: A direct restricted pair is rejected
Repeated friendships inside one component are accepted
A rejected request must not partially merge components
